name: Bartolo's Yeti Fur Cloak

angles.text: Bartolo boasts that his Yeti Fur Cloak is renowned throughout the Alliance, offering his tailoring services directly from the Alliance stronghold of Southshore.
Crafting the luxurious garment relies on core tailoring supplies, specifically a Bolt of Wool and Fine Thread, combined with exotic beast pelts.

faq.answer: Bartolo Ginsetti is an eccentric, boastful craftsman residing in Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He proudly proclaims himself to be the creator of an unrivaled, world-famous Yeti Fur Cloak.
To fashion his renowned cloak, Bartolo Ginsetti requires a Bolt of Wool, a Hillman's Cloak crafted by a leatherworker, a spool of Fine Thread, and ten clumps of thick Yeti Fur.
faq.q: What materials does Bartolo require to make the cloak?

faq.answer: Southshore is a coastal human town and the primary Alliance hub in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Bartolo Ginsetti operates out of this settlement, welcoming adventurers traveling through the region.
faq.q: Where does Bartolo make his cloaks?

faq.answer: Clumps of Yeti Fur are gathered from the wild yetis that inhabit the foothills and mountains of the Hillsbrad and Alterac region, prized for their dense and insulating coats.
faq.q: Where do adventurers obtain Yeti Fur in Hillsbrad?

faq.answer: The Hillman's Cloak serves as the foundational garment for Bartolo's creation. It is patterned and stitched by skilled leatherworkers before Bartolo layers it with fine thread, wool, and fur.
faq.q: How is the Hillman's Cloak acquired?

faq.answer: According to Bartolo himself, no finer cloak exists across the planet. He touts it as an Alliance-renowned garment that offers unmatched warmth, luxury, and prestige to whoever wears it.
faq.q: Why does Bartolo claim his cloak is world famous?

sections.body: In the coastal haven of Southshore, an artisan named Bartolo Ginsetti offers travelers the opportunity to commission his self-proclaimed masterpiece: the world-famous Yeti Fur Cloak. Bartolo maintains a reputation of bombastic self-confidence, claiming that no finer garment exists across the entire planet. While his boastful demeanor turns heads, his craft relies on a blend of local wilderness harvesting and the refined work of allied trades.
sections.title: The Grand Tailor of Southshore

sections.body: Crafting the luxurious cloak is no simple matter of stitching a pelt together. Bartolo requires adventurers to assemble an array of specific goods: standard tailoring staples including a Bolt of Wool and Fine Thread, a durable leather base known as a Hillman's Cloak, and ten dense clumps of Yeti Fur harvested from the beasts roaming the foothills. Once assembled, Bartolo works the raw materials into his signature cold-weather mantle.
sections.title: Components of the Craft

summary: Bartolo's Yeti Fur Cloak is a task offered by the eccentric artisan Bartolo Ginsetti in Southshore. Bartolo claims to craft an Alliance-renowned mantle of peerless quality, requiring adventurers to collect tailoring staples, a leatherworker's cloak, and raw yeti pelts.
attribution: In-game quest text: Bartolo's Yeti Fur Cloak
